Our results quantitatively demonstrate performance disparities across models and tasks, and highlight a substantial gap between current MLLM capabilities and human expert performance in front-end engineering. The FullFront benchmark and code are available in https://github.com/Mikivishy/FullFront.

AI.title_translation: FullFront：跨完整前端工程工作流的多模态大模型基准测试
AI.tldr: FullFront是一个全新的多模态大模型基准测试，用于评估模型在涵盖设计、感知和代码生成的完整前端工程工作流中的表现，揭示了当前模型与人类专家的巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的前端基准测试主要集中在将视觉设计转换为代码，忽略了真实前端工程中包含构思、理解和迭代细化等完整工作流的复杂性。
AI.method: 提出名为FullFront的基准测试，涵盖网页设计、网页感知问答和网页代码生成三个核心任务；采用新颖的两阶段处理流程，将真实网页转化为干净、标准化的HTML，同时保持视觉设计多样性并避免版权问题。
AI.result: 广泛测试表明，现有最先进的MLLM在页面感知、代码生成（图像处理和布局）以及交互实现方面存在明显不足，且与人类专家存在巨大性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的多模态大模型在完整的前端工程工作流中表现出显著的局限性，特别是在页面感知、代码生成（尤其是图像处理和布局）以及交互实现方面，与人类专家水平仍有较大差距。
AI.translation: 前端工程涉及一个复杂的流程，工程师在这个流程中构思设计、将其转化为代码，并迭代改进实现。虽然最近的基准测试主要集中在将视觉设计转换为代码，但我们提出了FullFront，这是一个旨在评估多模态大模型跨整个前端开发管道的基准。FullFront评估了三个直接映射到前端工程管道的基本任务：网页设计（构思阶段）、网页感知QA（理解视觉组织和元素）以及网页代码生成（实现阶段）。与现有的使用带有臃肿代码的抓取网站或过度简化的LLM生成HTML的基准不同，FullFront采用了一种新颖的两阶段过程，将真实世界的网页转换为干净、标准化的HTML，同时保持多样化的视觉设计并避免版权问题。对最先进的MLLM的广泛测试揭示了它们在页面感知、代码 generation（特别是图像处理和布局）以及交互实现方面的显着局限性。我们的结果定量地证明了不同模型和任务之间的性能差异，并突出了当前MLLM能力与前端工程中人类专家水平之间的实质性差距。FullFront基准测试和代码可在https://github.com/Mikivishy/FullFront获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了FullFront，这是一个旨在评估多模态大模型在完整前端开发工作流中表现的基准测试。FullFront包含网页设计、网页感知问答和网页代码生成三个核心任务，并通过两阶段流程将真实网页转换为干净、标准化的HTML。实验结果揭示了当前模型在感知、代码生成和交互实现上的重大局限性与性能差距。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 前端工程, 基准测试, 网页代码生成, 视觉感知
AI.comments: FullFront填补了现有评测仅关注“设计图转代码”的空白，将评测扩展到了包含网页设计、网页感知问答和代码生成的完整前端工程工作流，对评估多模态大模型在真实工业场景中的能力具有重要意义。

title: Differential Privacy of Decentralized Learning: Centralized Rate Conditions and Nearly Tight Guarantees
summary: We analyze the differential privacy of gossip averaging on a graph with independent Gaussian noise at every node, as seen by a subset of observing nodes. We characterize the privacy loss of any sensitive node over multiple gossip steps as that of a Gaussian mechanism whose sensitivity is the solution to a binary quadratic problem with a coefficient matrix determined by the gossip matrix. We recognize this matrix as a Toeplitz matrix plus a small correction, and show that its Toeplitz symbol controls how the DP guarantees grow with the number of steps. Under a computable condition on the Toeplitz symbol, the privacy guarantee matches that of a trusted central aggregator, and we give a utility bound for strongly convex learning problems that similarly matches the centralized case. Finally, we give numerical recipes for upper and lower bounds on the DP guarantees. On realistic test cases, the two bounds agree to within a few percent.

AI.title_translation: 去中心化学习的差分隐私：集中式速率条件和近乎紧密的保证
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了去中心化学习中的差分隐私问题，提出了一个条件，在该条件下，去中心化学习的隐私保证可以与集中式聚合器相媲美，并提供了实用的界限计算方法。
AI.motivation: 分析在去中心化学习场景下，节点之间通过“流言蜚语”聚合（gossip averaging）的差分隐私保证。
AI.method: 通过分析高斯噪声在图上的传播，将隐私损失表征为高斯机制，其敏感度由一个二元二次问题的解决定。该问题与图的流言蜚语矩阵相关。论文进一步利用了该矩阵的Toeplitz性质来分析隐私保证随迭代次数的增长情况。当满足一个可计算的Toeplitz符号条件时，隐私保证与集中式聚合器相当。论文还提供了计算隐私保证上下界的数值方法。
AI.result: 提出了一个可计算的条件，满足该条件时，去中心化学习的隐私保证与集中式聚合器相当。对于强凸学习问题，也得到了与集中式情况相匹配的效用界限。数值实验表明，计算出的上下界非常接近。
AI.conclusion: 在满足特定条件下，去中心化学习的差分隐私保证可以达到集中式聚合器的水平，并且可以通过数值方法获得紧密的隐私界限。
AI.translation: 我们分析了图上具有独立高斯噪声的流言蜚语聚合的差分隐私，该隐私由一组观察节点可见。我们将任何敏感节点在多个流言步骤上的隐私损失表征为高斯机制的隐私损失，其敏感度是二元二次问题的解，其系数矩阵由流言蜚语矩阵确定。我们将此矩阵识别为Toeplitz矩阵加上一个小的修正，并表明其Toeplitz符号控制着差分隐私保证随步数的增长。在Toeplitz符号的一个可计算条件下，隐私保证与受信任的中央聚合器相匹配，并且我们给出了强凸学习问题的效用界限，该界限也与中央情况相匹配。最后，我们给出了差分隐私保证上下界的数值方法。在实际测试用例上，两个界限在几个百分点内一致。
AI.summary: 本研究分析了在去中心化学习环境中，使用高斯噪声进行流言聚合的差分隐私（DP）保证。研究人员将隐私损失表征为高斯机制，其敏感度取决于一个与图的流言矩阵相关的二元二次问题的解。通过分析该矩阵的Toeplitz性质，论文得出了一个可计算的条件，在该条件下，去中心化学习的DP保证可以媲美集中式聚合器。此外，还为强凸学习问题提供了匹配的效用界限，并提出了一种计算DP保证上下界的数值方法，该方法在实验中显示出高度的一致性。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 去中心化学习, 流言聚合, 高斯机制, Toeplitz矩阵
AI.comments: 这项工作为理解和量化去中心化学习系统的差分隐私提供了一个重要的理论框架。通过将隐私保证与集中式聚合器进行比较，并提供可计算的条件和实用的数值方法，该研究为在实际应用中实现隐私保护的去中心化学习奠定了基础。未来的工作可以探索更广泛的噪声模型或更复杂的聚合协议。

title: On the Reliability and Stability of Selective Methods in Malware Classification Tasks
summary: The performance figures of modern drift-adaptive malware classifiers appear promising, but does this translate to genuine operational reliability? The standard evaluation paradigm primarily focuses on baseline performance metrics, neglecting confidence-error alignment and operational stability. While prior works established the importance of temporal evaluation and introduced selective classification in malware classification tasks, we take a complementary direction by investigating whether malware classifiers maintain reliable and stable confidence estimates under distribution shifts and exploring the tensions between scientific advancement and practical impacts when they do not. We propose Aurora, a framework to evaluate malware classifiers based on their confidence quality and operational resilience. Aurora subjects the confidence profile of a given model to verification to assess the reliability of its estimates. Unreliable confidence estimates erode operational trust, waste valuable annotation budgets on non-informative samples for active learning, and leave error-prone instances undetected in selective classification. Aurora is further complemented by a set of metrics designed to go beyond point-in-time performance, striving towards a more holistic assessment of operational stability throughout temporal evaluation periods. The fragility we observe in SOTA frameworks across datasets of varying drift severity suggests it may be time to revisit the underlying assumptions.

AI.title_translation: 论恶意软件分类任务中选择性方法的可靠性与稳定性
AI.tldr: 提出Aurora框架以评估恶意软件分类器在分布偏移下的置信度可靠性与操作稳定性，揭示了当前SOTA方法的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现代漂移自适应恶意软件分类器的性能评估主要集中在基线性能指标上，忽视了置信度-错误对齐和操作稳定性，导致其在实际操作中的真实可靠性存疑。
AI.method: 提出Aurora框架，通过对模型的置信度配置文件进行验证来评估其估计的可靠性，并配合一系列旨在超越特定时间点性能的指标，对整个时间评估期内的操作稳定性进行全面评估。
AI.result: 研究发现在不同漂移严重程度的数据集上，现有最先进（SOTA）的框架表现出脆弱性，表明其置信度估计不可靠，从而损害了操作信任、浪费了主动学习预算并使错误实例未被检测到。
AI.conclusion: 当前的先进恶意软件分类框架在分布偏移下面临显著的置信度脆弱性，亟需重新审视其底层假设并采用Aurora等更全面的评估框架。
AI.translation: 现代漂移自适应恶意软件分类器的性能数据看起来很有前景，但这是否转化为真正的操作可靠性？标准的评估范式主要关注基线性能指标，而忽视了置信度-错误对齐和操作稳定性。虽然先前的研究确立了时间评估的重要性并在恶意软件分类任务中引入了选择性分类，但我们采取了互补的方向：调查恶意软件分类器在分布偏移下是否能保持可靠且稳定的置信度估计，并探讨当它们不能时科学进步与实际影响之间的张力。我们提出了Aurora，一个根据恶意软件分类器的置信度质量和操作韧性对其进行评估的框架。Aurora对给定模型的置信度配置文件进行验证，以评估其估计的可靠性。不可靠的置信度估计会侵蚀操作信任，在主动学习中为无信息样本浪费宝贵的标注预算，并在选择性分类中使易错实例未被检测到。Aurora进一步辅以一套旨在超越单点性能的指标，力求在整个时间评估期内对操作稳定性进行更全面的评估。我们在不同漂移严重程度的数据集上观察到最先进（SOTA）框架的脆弱性，这表明可能是时候重新审视其底层假设了。
AI.summary: 该论文针对恶意软件分类任务，研究了分类器在分布偏移下保持可靠且稳定的置信度估计的能力，并提出了名为Aurora的评估框架，通过置信度质量和操作韧性指标来克服现有方法的脆弱性。
AI.keywords: 恶意软件分类, 选择性分类, 置信度可靠性, 操作稳定性, 分布偏移
AI.comments: 该论文指出了现有恶意软件分类器在面对概念漂移时缺乏可靠的置信度估计和操作稳定性，并提出了Aurora框架进行全面评估，对未来恶意软件检测系统的实际部署具有重要指导意义。

title: Doubly Robust Alignment for Large Language Models
summary: This paper studies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning large language models with human preferences. While RLHF has demonstrated promising results, many algorithms are highly sensitive to misspecifications in the underlying preference model (e.g., the Bradley-Terry model), the reference policy, or the reward function, resulting in undesirable fine-tuning. To address model misspecification, we propose a doubly robust preference optimization algorithm that remains consistent when either the preference model or the reference policy is correctly specified (without requiring both). Our proposal demonstrates superior and more robust performance than state-of-the-art algorithms, both in theory and in practice. The code is available at https://github.com/DRPO4LLM/DRPO4LLM

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型的双重稳健对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型RLHF的双重稳健偏好优化算法，有效解决了模型设定偏差带来的不良微调问题，具有优异的理论和实践性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLHF算法对底层偏好模型、参考策略或奖励函数的设定偏差高度敏感，容易导致不良的微调结果，因此需要解决模型设定偏差问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种双重稳健偏好优化算法，当偏好模型或参考策略中有一个被正确设定时，该算法就能保持一致性。
AI.result: 理论和实践表明，该方法比当前最优算法具有更优越和更稳健的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的双重稳健偏好优化算法能有效解决模型设定偏差问题，在理论上保证了一致性，并在实践中展现出卓越的稳健性能。
AI.translation: 本文研究了用于将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐的人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）。尽管RLHF已展示出美好的前景，但许多算法对底层偏好模型（如Bradley-Terry模型）、参考策略或奖励函数的设定偏差高度敏感，从而导致不良的微调结果。为了解决模型设定偏差问题，我们提出了一种双重稳健的偏好优化算法，该算法在偏好模型或参考策略之一被正确设定时就能保持一致性（无需两者同时正确）。无论在理论上还是在实践中，我们的方法都展现出比当前最先进算法更优越、更稳健的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/DRPO4LLM/DRPO4LLM 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大语言模型的人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）对齐问题，针对现有算法对模型设定的敏感性，提出了一种双重稳健偏好优化算法。该算法在偏好模型或参考策略之一正确设定时即可保持一致性，在理论和实践中均表现出优于当前最优方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 人类反馈强化学习, 模型偏差, 双重稳健优化, 偏好对齐
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中的模型设定偏差问题，提出了双重稳健偏好优化算法。这一方法在理论和实践上都展现出了优于现有SOTA算法的性能，对提高对齐的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Improved Regret Bounds for Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound in Bayesian Optimization
comments: 36 pages, NeurIPS 2025. In v3, I added a supplementary proof of the local quadratic condition and corrected typos and minor errors. No other changes were made
summary: This paper addresses the Bayesian optimization problem (also referred to as the Bayesian setting of the Gaussian process bandit), where the learner seeks to minimize the regret under a function drawn from a known Gaussian process (GP). Under a Matérn kernel with a certain degree of smoothness, we show that the Gaussian process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) algorithm achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ cumulative regret with high probability. Furthermore, our analysis yields $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$ regret under a squared exponential kernel. These results fill the gap between the existing regret upper bound for GP-UCB and the best-known bound provided by Scarlett (2018). The key idea in our proof is to capture the concentration behavior of the input sequence realized by GP-UCB, enabling a more refined analysis of the GP's information gain.
comment: 36 pages, NeurIPS 2025. In v3, I added a supplementary proof of the local quadratic condition and corrected typos and minor errors. No other changes were made

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯优化中高斯过程上置信界算法的改进遗憾界
AI.tldr: 该论文改进了高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法在Matérn核和平方指数核下的遗憾上界，填补了理论研究的空白。
AI.motivation: 为了填补高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法现有的遗憾上界与 Scarlett (2018) 提供的已知最佳界之间的差距。
AI.method: 通过捕捉由 GP-UCB 实现的输入序列的集中行为，对高斯过程的信息增益进行更精细的分析。
AI.result: 在具有特定平滑度的 Matérn 核下，GP-UCB 算法以高概率实现了 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 的累积遗憾；在平方指数核下，实现了 $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$ 的遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功改进了Matérn核和平方指数核下GP-UCB算法的遗憾上界，分别达到了 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 和 $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$，弥补了先前理论分析的空白。
AI.translation: 本文研究了贝叶斯优化问题（也称为高斯过程多臂机的贝叶斯设置），其中学习者试图在从已知高斯过程（GP）中抽取的函数下最小化遗憾。在具有一定平滑度的 Matérn 核下，我们证明了高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法以高概率实现了 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 的累积遗憾。此外，我们的分析在平方指数核下产生了 $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$ 的遗憾。这些结果填补了 GP-UCB 现有遗憾上界与 Scarlett (2018) 提供的已知最佳界之间的差距。我们证明中的核心思想是捕捉由 GP-UCB 实现的输入序列的集中行为，从而对 GP 的信息增益进行更精细的分析。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了贝叶斯优化中的高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法，通过精细化分析输入序列的集中行为和信息增益，成功改进了Matérn核和平方指数核下的遗憾上界，填补了现有理论的空白。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯优化, 高斯过程, 遗憾界, 上置信界, 信息增益
AI.comments: 该论文在理论上取得了重要进展，通过更精细的分析填补了GP-UCB算法现有 regret 上界与 Scarlett (2018) 最新最优界之间的差距，对高斯过程 bandit 和贝叶斯优化理论研究具有重要价值。

title: DART: Differentiable Dynamic Adaptive Region Tokenizer for Vision Foundation Models
summary: The content-agnostic, fixed-grid tokenizers used by standard large-scale vision models like Vision Transformer (ViT) and Vision Mamba (Vim) represent a fundamental performance bottleneck, creating a trade-off between capturing fine-grained detail and suffering from redundant computation. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce DART, a fully differentiable Dynamic Adaptive Region Tokenizer. DART employs learnable region scores and quantile-based partitioning to create content-aware patches of varying sizes, intelligently allocating a higher token density to information-rich regions. The impact of this approach is profound: it unlocks a more intelligent scaling paradigm, where a DART-equipped DeiT-Small (22M parameters) matches the performance of a DeiT-Base (86M) with nearly double the inference speed by efficiently capturing high-resolution details in key regions. Furthermore, the principle of adaptive tokenization proves its generality with clear benefits in dense prediction and spatiotemporal video tasks. We argue that by resolving the tokenizer bottleneck at its source, adaptive tokenization is a key component for building the next generation of more efficient and capable foundation models for multimodal AI, robotics, and content generation. Code is available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/DART.

AI.title_translation: DART：面向视觉基础模型的全可导动态自适应区域分词器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DART的全可导动态自适应区域分词器，它能根据图像内容智能调整Token密度，在大幅提升推理速度的同时保持高模型性能。
AI.motivation: 标准大规模视觉模型（如ViT和Vim）使用的与内容无关的固定网格分词器存在根本性的性能瓶颈，导致在捕捉细粒度细节和避免冗余计算之间陷入两难境地。
AI.method: 引入了全可导的动态自适应区域分词器（DART），利用可学习的区域评分和基于分位数的划分机制，生成不同大小的内容感知图像块，并在信息丰富的区域分配更高的Token密度。
AI.result: 配备DART的DeiT-Small（22M参数）在几乎两倍的推理速度下，达到了与DeiT-Base（86M参数）相匹配的性能，并在密集预测和时空视频任务中展现出明显的通用优势。
AI.conclusion: DART通过内容感知的自适应分词，从根本上突破了传统视觉模型的性能瓶颈，为构建下一代高效且功能强大的多模态AI、机器人及内容生成基础模型铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 诸如Vision Transformer (ViT)和Vision Mamba (Vim)等标准大规模视觉模型所采用的与内容无关的固定网格分词器，代表了一种根本性的性能瓶颈，在捕捉细粒度细节和遭受冗余计算之间造成了权衡困境。为了解决这一困境，我们推出了DART——一种完全可导的动态自适应区域分词器（Dynamic Adaptive Region Tokenizer）。DART利用可学习的区域分数和基于分位数的划分来创建大小可变的内容感知图像块，智能地为信息丰富的区域分配更高的Token密度。这种方法的影响是深远的：它开启了一个更智能的扩展范式，配备DART的DeiT-Small（22M参数）以近乎两倍的推理速度匹配了DeiT-Base（86M）的性能，通过在关键区域高效捕获高分辨率细节。此外，自适应分词的原则在密集预测和时空视频任务中展现出了明显的优势，证明了其通用性。我们认为，通过从源头解决分词器瓶颈，自适应分词是构建面向多模态AI、机器人和内容生成的下一代更高效、更有能力的基础模型的关键组件。代码可在 https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/DART 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DART，一种全可导的动态自适应区域分词器，旨在解决视觉基础模型中固定网格分词的性能瓶颈。通过可学习的分区和自适应Token分配，DART在保持高推理速度的同时显著提升了模型捕获高分辨率细节的能力。
AI.keywords: Vision Foundation Models, Tokenizer, Differentiable, Dynamic Adaptive, Region Partitioning
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种全可导的动态自适应区域分词器（DART），创新性地解决了视觉基础模型中固定网格分词带来的计算冗余与细节捕获之间的矛盾，具有很高的计算效率和通用性。

title: Data-Driven Maintenance Optimization: Aligning Prognostic Learning with Decision Objective
summary: Estimation error in machine learning prognostic models can propagate into poor maintenance decisions. We study a data-driven predictive maintenance problem coupling health-condition estimation with a joint ordering-replacement model. We show that the conventional Estimate-Then-Optimize (ETO) approach yields inconsistent, suboptimal decisions for a broad class of such problems. To bridge the gap, we propose an Integrated Estimate-Optimize (IEO) framework that directly targets maintenance cost as the prognostic learning objective, bypassing surrogate statistical accuracy metrics such as Kullback--Leibler divergence or mean squared error. Theoretically, we prove out-of-sample performance guarantees of the IEO framework under certain conditions, including i.i.d. and sliding-window data-generating processes. Computationally, we develop a training procedure combining Monte Carlo dropout, central-difference gradient approximation, and an ETO warm-start to handle discrete maintenance decisions and nonlinear costs. Experiments on the four CMAPSS subsets demonstrate that, under the nominal setting, IEO reduces mean maintenance cost by 14.8--22.7% relative to ETO and by 7.2--11.8% relative to a decision-oriented baseline, while also reducing failure rates and cost variation. These improvements are obtained despite higher prediction errors. Increasing the ratio of unplanned-downtime costs to planned-downtime costs makes this tradeoff more pronounced: IEO shifts predictions further toward RUL underestimation, accompanied by greater cost savings and fewer failures. These findings support aligning prognostic learning with maintenance objectives when imperfect predictions must guide decisions under costly unplanned downtime.

AI.title_translation: 数据驱动的维护优化：将预测学习与决策目标对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为IEO的预测性维护框架，通过直接以维护成本（而非传统统计误差）为学习目标，显著降低了设备的维护成本和故障率。
AI.motivation: 传统的“先估计后优化”（ETO）方法在机器学习预测模型中容易导致估计误差传播，从而做出次优的维护决策，亟需一种能够将健康状态估计与联合订购-更换模型直接对齐的方法。
AI.method: 提出集成估计-优化（IEO）框架，直接以维护成本作为预测学习目标，并在计算上结合了蒙特卡洛Dropout、中心差分梯度近似以及ETO热启动来处理离散维护决策和非线性成本。
AI.result: 在CMAPSS数据集上的实验表明，IEO在名义设置下将平均维护成本较ETO降低了14.8-22.7%，较决策导向基线降低了7.2-11.8%，同时降低了故障率和成本波动。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预测学习与决策目标对齐，IEO框架能够在牺牲部分预测精度的前提下，显著降低预测性维护的总体成本和故障率，特别是在高额计划外停机成本的场景下优势明显。
AI.translation: 机器学习预测模型中的估计误差可能会传递并导致不佳的维护决策。我们研究了一个将健康状况估计与联合订购-更换模型相结合的数据驱动预测性维护问题。我们发现，传统的“先估计-后优化”（ETO）方法对于此类广泛的问题会产生不一致的、次优的决策。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个集成的“估计-优化”（IEO）框架，该框架直接以维护成本作为预测学习的目标，绕过了诸如Kullback-Leibler散度或均方误差等替代统计准确性指标。在理论上，我们在独立同分布（i.i.d.）和滑动窗口数据生成过程等特定条件下证明了IEO框架的样本外性能保证。在计算上，我们开发了一种结合了蒙特卡洛Dropout、中心差分梯度近似以及ETO热启动的训练程序，以处理离散维护决策和非线性成本。在CMAPSS四个子集上的实验表明，在标称设置下，IEO将平均维护成本比ETO降低了14.8-22.7%，比面向决策的基线降低了7.2-11.8%，同时还降低了故障率和成本变异性。尽管预测误差更高，但仍取得了这些改进。增加计划外停机成本与计划内停机成本的比率使得这种权衡更加明显：IEO将预测进一步转向剩余寿命（RUL）低估，伴随着更大的成本节约和更少的故障。这些发现支持在必须由不完美预测来指导高成本计划外停机情况下的决策时，将预测学习与维护目标进行对齐。
AI.summary: 本文研究了数据驱动的预测性维护问题，提出了一种将健康状况估计与联合订购-更换模型相耦合的集成估计-优化（IEO）框架。理论和实验证明，该方法直接针对维护成本进行学习，有效克服了传统ETO方法的缺陷，显著降低了维护成本和系统故障率。
AI.keywords: 预测性维护, 数据驱动优化, 机器学习, 成本最小化, 估计与优化集成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地指出了传统“先估计后优化”（ETO）方法在预测性维护中的局限性，提出了集成估计-优化（IEO）框架，直接以维护成本为学习目标，实现了从“追求预测准确率”向“追求决策最优性”的范式转变，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用意义。

title: HiMA-Ecom: A Long-Horizon Memory Benchmark for Hierarchical Multi-Agent E-commerce Assistants
comments: 33 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Long-horizon agentic systems become long-context systems by accumulation rather than through a single long document, since every step reassembles a prompt from role instructions, tool and sub-agent descriptions, recalled memories, dialogue history, and previous tool outputs, separately for every agent. This paper studies how such accumulated context can be trained, evaluated, and managed in hierarchical multi-agent assistants. We present HiMA-Ecom, a hierarchical multi-agent benchmark for e-commerce assistants with 22.8K instances, of which 17.7K carry memory entries in context, pairing agent-specific supervised fine-tuning data with system-level supervision for end-to-end multi-agent reinforcement learning. Building upon it, HiMA-R1 keeps the context budget of a trajectory under control through Variance-Reduction Group Relative Policy Optimization (VR-GRPO), which samples along an initial trajectory so that sampling cost grows additively with trajectory length and updates the agents with the largest reward variance, together with an efficiency reward on trajectory length and a memory evolution mechanism that repurposes GRPO rewards as cost-free signals for what stays in context. Agents built upon 3B and 7B open-source models match DeepSeek-R1 and surpass DeepSeek-V3 by 6.0 points on average, while reward-driven memory reduces the update steps needed for convergence by roughly 55%.
comment: 33 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM), NeurIPS 2026

AI.title_translation: HiMA-Ecom：面向分层多智能体电商助手的长视野记忆基准
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个用于分层多智能体电商助手的长视野记忆基准HiMA-Ecom和HiMA-R1训练方法，通过高效的上下文管理和记忆演化机制，显著提升了开源模型的长视野任务处理能力并大幅减少了收敛步骤。
AI.motivation: 长视野智能体系统通过逐步累积（如角色指令、工具描述、回忆记忆、对话历史和工具输出）演变为长文本系统，这给分层多智能体助手的训练、评估和上下文管理带来了挑战，亟需专门的基准和方法来解决。
AI.method: 提出HiMA-Ecom基准（包含22.8K实例），并基于该基准开发了HiMA-R1方法。该方法采用方差约减群相对策略优化（VR-GRPO）来控制上下文预算、结合轨迹长度的高效奖励以及利用GRPO奖励作为无成本信号的记忆演化机制。
AI.result: 基于3B和7B开源模型的智能体性能表现优异，平均超越DeepSeek-V3达6.0个百分点，并与DeepSeek-R1相当；同时，奖励驱动的记忆机制将收敛所需的更新步骤减少了约55%。
AI.conclusion: HiMA-Ecom基准和HiMA-R1方法通过创新的VR-GRPO和记忆演化机制，成功解决了分层多智能体在长视野任务中的上下文累积和记忆管理难题，在保持高效的同时显著提升了模型性能。
AI.translation: 长视野智能体系统通过累积而非单个长文档变成长上下文系统，因为每一步都为每个智能体重新组装包含角色指令、工具和子智能体描述、回忆的记忆、对话历史以及先前工具输出的提示词。本文研究了如何在分层多智能体助手中训练、评估和管理这种累积的上下文。我们提出了HiMA-Ecom，这是一个包含22.8K实例的电商分层多智能体基准，其中17.7K实例在上下文中带有记忆条目，将智能体特定的监督微调数据与端到端多智能体强化学习的系统级监督相结合。在此基础上，HiMA-R1通过方差约减群相对策略优化（VR-GRPO）将轨迹的上下文预算控制在一定范围内，该优化沿初始轨迹采样，使采样成本随轨迹长度呈加法增长并更新具有最大奖励方差的智能体，同时结合了关于轨迹长度的高效奖励以及将GRPO奖励重新用作上下文中保留内容的无成本信号的记忆演化机制。基于3B和7B开源模型构建的智能体平均超越DeepSeek-V3达6.0个百分点，并与DeepSeek-R1相匹配，而奖励驱动的记忆机制将收敛所需的更新步骤减少了约55%。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了分层多智能体电商助手的长视野记忆和上下文管理问题。文章推出了HiMA-Ecom基准，并提出了HiMA-R1方法，利用VR-GRPO和记忆演化机制有效控制上下文预算并提高训练效率，在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 长视野记忆, 分层多智能体, 电子商务助手, 强化学习, 上下文管理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种针对分层多智能体电商助手的长视野记忆基准和训练方法（HiMA-Ecom与HiMA-R1），通过方差约减群相对策略优化（VR-GRPO）和奖励驱动的记忆演化机制，有效控制了长文本累积带来的上下文膨胀问题，在开源模型上实现了对强力闭源模型的超越，具有重要的实际应用价值和创新性。

title: A Benchmark Library for Distributed Power System Analysis and Optimization
summary: DPLib is an open-source benchmark library created to support research and development in distributed power system analysis and optimization. Unlike centralized tools such as MATPOWER and PGLib, no general purpose, reproducible data library package currently exists for distributed power system studies. DPLib, available at \href{https://github.com/LSU-RAISE-LAB/DPLib.git}{GitHub}, fills this gap by providing 40 multi-region benchmark test cases ranging from 5 buses to 20758 buses, along with a graph-based partitioning toolkit that converts MATPOWER-compatible systems into distributed regional datasets. The toolkit generates standardized \texttt{.mat}, \texttt{.csv}, and \texttt{.m} files, regional MATPOWER version 2 cases, local and global bus mappings, generator and cost assignments, explicit inter-regional tie-line records, and bus-to-region partition maps. It supports unweighted, electrically weighted, and user-defined partitions, and is compared with METIS, KaFFPa, and an IPA-inspired baseline. DPLib also provides ADMM-based distributed DC and AC OPF solvers for validation. Numerical studies report partitioning sensitivity, centralized run times, distributed OPF iterations, run times, and optimality gaps. These results establish DPLib as a reproducible data layer for distributed power system research.

AI.title_translation: 分布式电力系统分析与优化基准库
AI.tldr: DPLib是一个开源基准库，用于分布式电力系统分析与优化，填补了现有工具的空白。它提供40个不同规模的多区域测试案例，并包含一个基于图的分割工具包，可将集中式系统转换为分布式数据集。该库还提供ADMM优化求解器进行验证，并通过数值研究展示了其在分区敏感性、运行时间和优化精度方面的性能。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏用于分布式电力系统研究的通用、可复现的数据集库，DPLib旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: DPLib提供了一个开源基准库，包含40个不同规模的多区域测试案例，并开发了一个基于图的分割工具包，用于将集中式系统转换为分布式数据集。该工具包生成多种格式的数据文件，并支持不同的分区方式。此外，还提供了基于ADMM的分布式直流和交流最优潮流（OPF）求解器进行验证。
AI.result: 数值研究报告了分区敏感性、集中式运行时间、分布式OPF迭代次数、运行时间和最优性差距。
AI.conclusion: DPLib为分布式电力系统研究提供了一个可复现的数据层。
AI.translation: DPLib是一个开源的基准库，旨在支持分布式电力系统分析和优化的研究与开发。与MATPOWER和PGLib等集中式工具不同，目前不存在用于分布式电力系统研究的通用、可复现的数据集包。DPLib（可在GitHub上找到）通过提供40个从5个节点到20758个节点的多区域基准测试案例，以及一个基于图的分割工具包（可将兼容MATPOWER的系统转换为分布式区域数据集），来填补这一空白。该工具包生成标准化的.mat、.csv和.m文件、区域MATPOWER版本2案例、本地和全局节点映射、发电机和成本分配、显式的区域间联络线记录以及节点到区域的划分图。它支持无权重、电气权重和用户定义的划分，并与METIS、KaFFPa和受IPA启发的基线进行了比较。DPLib还提供了基于ADMM的分布式直流和交流最优潮流（OPF）求解器进行验证。数值研究报告了分区敏感性、集中式运行时间、分布式OPF迭代次数、运行时间和最优性差距。这些结果确立了DPLib作为分布式电力系统研究的可复现数据层。
AI.summary: DPLib是一个新推出的开源基准库，旨在为分布式电力系统分析和优化提供支持。它包含了40个不同规模的多区域测试案例，并配备了一个图分割工具包，可以将现有的集中式电力系统模型转换为适合分布式研究的数据集。该库还集成了ADMM优化求解器，并进行了广泛的数值验证，证明了其在分布式电力系统研究中的可行性和可复现性。
AI.keywords: 分布式电力系统, 基准库, 最优潮流, 图分割, ADMM
AI.comments: 该库的创新之处在于提供了一个专门针对分布式电力系统研究的、可复现的数据集和工具包，填补了现有研究的空白。其模块化的设计和多样化的测试案例使其成为该领域的重要资源。未来的工作可以进一步扩展测试案例的多样性，并集成更多先进的分布式优化算法。

title: An Unconditional Lower Bound for the Active-Set Method in Almost-Linear Programming
summary:
We prove that, for every fixed $ε\in(0,1]$, the active-set method requires exponentially many iterations in the worst case to maximize a convex objective of the form $(x_1)^{1+ε}+\vec c^{\top}\vec x$ subject to linear constraints, regardless of the pivot rule used. Our lower bound therefore holds for objectives arbitrarily close to the linear case $ε=0$, where the active-set method coincides with the simplex method and a lower bound for all pivot rules would constitute a major breakthrough. The special case $ε=1$ yields a lower bound in convex quadratic maximization. This improves on the best previously known lower bound [IPCO 2025] requiring polynomial objectives of degree $ω(\log d)$ in dimension $d$ and firmly resolves the open question of whether a constant degree suffices.
  Our result is based on a novel extended formulation, recursively constructed using deformed products. Its key feature is that it projects onto a polygonal approximation of a parabola while preserving all of its exponentially many vertices. We define a convex objective with a single non-linear variable that forces the active-set method to follow the parabolic boundary of this projection, without allowing any shortcuts along chords corresponding to edges of its full-dimensional preimage.

AI.title_translation: 几乎线性规划中主动集方法的无条件下界
AI.tldr: 主动集方法在近似线性规划中需要指数级迭代次数，解决了长期存在的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 证明主动集方法在近似线性规划中的下界，特别是对于接近线性情况的目标函数。解决了多项式目标函数是否需要常数度数这一开放问题，并改进了现有结果。
AI.method: 基于一种新颖的扩展公式，通过变形积递归构建。该公式投影到一个抛物线的多边形近似上，保留了指数级的顶点，并迫使主动集方法沿着抛物线边界移动。
AI.result: 证明了对于任意固定的$ε\in(0,1]$，主动集方法在最坏情况下需要指数级迭代次数来最大化形如$(x_1)^{1+ε}+\vec c^{\top}\vec x$的凸目标函数，且不受枢轴规则影响。该结果适用于任意接近线性情况的目标函数，并在$ε=1$时给出了凸二次最大化的下界。它明确解决了常数度数是否足够这一开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 主动集方法在近似线性规划问题中具有无条件的指数下界，即使目标函数任意接近线性情况。这明确解决了该领域的一个长期存在的开放问题。
AI.translation: 我们证明，对于每一个固定的$ε\in(0,1]$，主动集方法在最坏情况下需要指数级迭代次数来最大化形如$(x_1)^{1+ε}+\vec c^{\top}\vec x$的凸目标函数，受线性约束，而与所使用的枢轴规则无关。因此，我们的下界适用于任意接近线性情况$ε=0$的目标函数，在此情况下主动集方法与单纯形法一致，并且对所有枢轴规则的下界将构成一项重大突破。特殊情况$ε=1$在凸二次最大化中产生了下界。这改进了之前已知的最佳下界[IPCO 2025]，该下界要求维度$d$中多项式目标函数的度数为$ω(\log d)$，并明确解决了常数度数是否足够这一开放问题。我们的结果基于一种新颖的扩展公式，通过变形积递归构建。其关键特征在于它投影到抛物线的多边形近似上，同时保留了其所有指数级的顶点。我们定义了一个具有单个非线性变量的凸目标函数，该函数迫使主动集方法遵循此投影的抛物线边界，而不允许沿对应于其全维度原像边缘的弦进行任何捷径。
AI.summary: 本文证明了在近似线性规划问题中，主动集方法（特别是对于形如$(x_1)^{1+ε}+\vec c^{\top}\vec x$的凸目标函数）存在无条件的指数级下界。这一发现适用于任意接近线性情况的目标函数，并解决了关于多项式目标函数所需度数的长期开放问题，改进了现有界限。该证明基于一种新颖的扩展公式，该公式迫使该方法遍历一个指数级复杂的抛物线边界。
AI.keywords: 主动集方法, 下界, 近似线性规划, 凸最大化, 指数迭代
AI.comments: 本文通过引入一种新颖的扩展公式，明确证明了主动集方法在近似线性规划中存在无条件的指数级下界。这不仅解决了该领域一个长期存在的开放问题，即多项式目标函数是否需要常数度数，而且显著改进了先前的最佳下界。该成果对于理解主动集方法的理论复杂性及其在接近线性规划问题中的性能具有重要意义。

title: BadTime: An Effective Backdoor Attack on Multivariate Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate long-term time series forecasting (MLTSF) models are increasingly deployed in critical domains such as climate, finance, and transportation. Despite their growing importance, the security of MLTSF models against backdoor attacks remains entirely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose BadTime, the first effective backdoor attack tailored for MLTSF. BadTime can manipulate hundreds of future predictions toward a target pattern by injecting a subtle trigger. BadTime addresses two key challenges that become particularly severe in MLTSF: (i) the rapid dilution of local triggers over long horizons, and (ii) the extreme sparsity of backdoor signals under stealth constraints. To counter dilution, BadTime leverages inter-variable correlations, temporal lags, and data-driven initialization to design a distributed, lag-aware trigger whose influence persists over long-range forecasts. To overcome sparsity, it mixes label-similar and label-dissimilar poisoned samples and adopts a decoupled backdoor training objective that explicitly up-weights the sparse backdoor signal, enabling reliable learning at a poisoning rate as low as 1%. Extensive experiments show that BadTime significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art backdoor attack on time series forecasting by extending the attackable horizon from at most 12 timesteps to 720 timesteps (a 60x improvement) and reducing the MAE on target variables by 57% on average, while changing the average clean forecasting error by less than 1%.

AI.title_translation: BadTime：一种针对多元长期时间序列预测的有效后门攻击
AI.tldr: BadTime是第一个针对多元长期时间序列预测（MLTSF）的有效后门攻击，通过注入一个细微的触发器来操纵数百个未来预测，并且在攻击范围和效果上显著优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 多元长期时间序列预测（MLTSF）模型在气候、金融和交通等关键领域日益部署，但其针对后门攻击的安全性尚未被探索，因此提出了BadTime来填补这一空白。
AI.method: BadTime通过设计一个分布式、滞后感知的触发器来对抗局部触发器在长期预测中的稀释问题，该触发器利用变量间相关性、时间滞后和数据驱动初始化。为克服稀疏性，它混合了标签相似和标签不相似的投毒样本，并采用解耦的后门训练目标，明确提高稀疏后门信号的权重，从而在低至1%的投毒率下实现可靠学习。
AI.result: BadTime将可攻击的预测范围从最多12个时间步扩展到720个时间步（提高了60倍），平均将目标变量的MAE降低了57%，同时对平均干净预测误差的影响小于1%。
AI.conclusion: BadTime是第一个专门针对MLTSF的有效后门攻击，成功解决了长期预测中触发器稀释和后门信号稀疏性两大挑战，并显著优于现有技术。
AI.translation: 多元长期时间序列预测（MLTSF）模型越来越多地部署在气候、金融和交通等关键领域。尽管它们的重要性日益增长，但MLTSF模型针对后门攻击的安全性仍完全未被探索。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了BadTime，这是第一个专为MLTSF量身定制的有效后门攻击。BadTime可以通过注入一个细微的触发器来操纵数百个未来预测，使其符合目标模式。BadTime解决了在MLTSF中变得尤为严重的两个关键挑战：(i) 局部触发器在长期预测中迅速稀释，以及 (ii) 在隐蔽性约束下后门信号的极端稀疏性。为了对抗稀释，BadTime利用变量间相关性、时间滞后和数据驱动初始化来设计一个分布式、滞后感知的触发器，其影响在长期预测中持续存在。为了克服稀疏性，它混合了标签相似和标签不相似的投毒样本，并采用解耦的后门训练目标，明确提高稀疏后门信号的权重，从而在低至1%的投毒率下实现可靠学习。广泛的实验表明，BadTime显著优于现有时间序列预测后门攻击，将可攻击的预测范围从最多12个时间步扩展到720个时间步（提高了60倍），平均将目标变量的MAE降低了57%，同时对平均干净预测误差的影响小于1%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BadTime，这是首个针对多元长期时间序列预测（MLTSF）模型的有效后门攻击。该攻击通过注入细微触发器来操纵长期预测结果，并解决了传统后门攻击在MLTSF中面临的触发器稀释和信号稀疏性问题。BadTime设计了分布式、滞后感知的触发器，并采用解耦的训练目标，使其在极低投毒率下仍能有效攻击720个时间步，显著提升了攻击范围和效果。
AI.keywords: 后门攻击, 多元时间序列预测, 长期预测, 触发器稀释, 信号稀疏性
AI.comments: 该论文首次探索了多元长期时间序列预测模型的后门攻击，填补了重要的安全空白。BadTime通过创新性地解决长期预测中的触发器稀释和信号稀疏性问题，将攻击范围和效果提升了数十倍，显示出其方法的有效性和对未来相关研究的潜在影响。在实际应用中，这突显了MLTSF模型在部署前进行严格安全评估的重要性。

title: PIS3R: Very Large Parallax Image Stitching via Deep 3D Reconstruction
summary: Image stitching aim to align two images taken from different viewpoints into one seamless, wider image. However, when the 3D scene contains depth variations and the camera baseline is significant, noticeable parallax occurs-meaning the relative positions of scene elements differ substantially between views. Most existing stitching methods struggle to handle such images with large parallax effectively. To address this challenge, in this paper, we propose an image stitching solution called PIS3R that is robust to very large parallax based on the novel concept of deep 3D reconstruction. First, we apply visual geometry grounded transformer to two input images with very large parallax to obtain both intrinsic and extrinsic parameters, as well as the dense 3D scene reconstruction. Subsequently, we reproject reconstructed dense point cloud onto a designated reference view using the recovered camera parameters, achieving pixel-wise alignment and generating an initial stitched image. Finally, to further address potential artifacts such as holes or noise in the initial stitching, we propose a point-conditioned image diffusion module to obtain the refined result.Compared with existing methods, our solution is very large parallax tolerant and also provides results that fully preserve the geometric integrity of all pixels in the 3D photogrammetric context, enabling direct applicability to downstream 3D vision tasks such as SfM. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm provides accurate stitching results for images with very large parallax, and outperforms the existing methods qualitatively and quantitatively.

AI.title_translation: PIS3R：基于深度3D重建的超大视差图像拼接
AI.tldr: PIS3R提出一种基于深度3D重建的图像拼接方法，能有效处理超大视差图像，并提供几何完整性，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像拼接方法在处理包含深度变化和显著相机基线的3D场景时，难以有效应对由超大视差引起的图像元素相对位置差异，导致拼接效果不佳。
AI.method: PIS3R首先使用视觉几何Transformer从两张超大视差图像中获取内外参及稠密3D场景重建。然后，将重建的稠密点云通过恢复的相机参数重投影到指定参考视图，实现像素级对齐并生成初始拼接图像。最后，通过点条件图像扩散模块进一步精炼结果，解决初始拼接中的孔洞或噪声等潜在伪影。
AI.result: PIS3R对超大视差具有很强的容忍性，并能完全保留3D摄影测量背景下所有像素的几何完整性，使其可以直接应用于SfM等下游3D视觉任务。实验结果表明，该算法能为超大视差图像提供准确的拼接结果，并在定性和定量上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PIS3R算法能够准确拼接具有超大视差的图像，并显著优于现有方法，同时保持了3D几何完整性。
AI.translation: 图像拼接旨在将从不同视点拍摄的两张图像对齐成一张无缝、更宽的图像。然而，当3D场景包含深度变化且相机基线较大时，会产生明显的视差——这意味着场景元素的相对位置在不同视图之间存在显著差异。大多数现有的拼接方法难以有效处理这种具有大视差的图像。为了应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种名为PIS3R的图像拼接解决方案，该方案基于新颖的深度3D重建概念，对超大视差具有鲁棒性。首先，我们应用视觉几何Transformer对两张具有超大视差的输入图像进行处理，以获取内参和外参，以及稠密的3D场景重建。随后，我们使用恢复的相机参数将重建的稠密点云重投影到指定的参考视图上，实现像素级对齐并生成初始拼接图像。最后，为了进一步解决初始拼接中可能出现的孔洞或噪声等伪影，我们提出了一个点条件图像扩散模块来获得精炼结果。与现有方法相比，我们的解决方案对超大视差具有很强的容忍性，并且提供的结果能完全保留3D摄影测量背景下所有像素的几何完整性，使其可以直接应用于SfM等下游3D视觉任务。实验结果表明，所提出的算法为具有超大视差的图像提供了准确的拼接结果，并在定性和定量上均优于现有方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PIS3R，一种基于深度3D重建的图像拼接方法，旨在解决现有方法难以处理超大视差图像的问题。该方法首先通过视觉几何Transformer进行3D场景重建并获取相机参数，然后将点云重投影实现像素级对齐生成初始拼接图像，最后利用点条件图像扩散模块精炼结果。PIS3R对超大视差具有鲁棒性，能保持像素的几何完整性，并可应用于下游3D视觉任务，实验证明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 图像拼接, 超大视差, 深度3D重建, 视觉几何Transformer, 图像扩散模型
AI.comments: PIS3R的创新点在于将深度3D重建与图像拼接相结合，并通过视觉几何Transformer和点条件图像扩散模块来处理超大视差和优化拼接效果。其强调保持3D几何完整性，为后续3D视觉任务提供了便利，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Role-Augmented Intent-Driven Generative Search Engine Optimization
summary: Generative search engines (GSEs), which combine large language models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), are reshaping how users access Web information and making source visibility and influence in generated responses new optimization objectives. Existing generative search engine optimization (G-SEO) methods seek to improve content visibility, but many rely on direct access to target queries or GSE feedback elicited by those queries. However, Web content is typically optimized and published before future user queries are known, making G-SEO without access to target queries or their associated feedback an important yet underexplored problem. To address this, we propose RAID, a Role-Augmented Intent-Driven G-SEO method that operates without access to target queries or query-dependent GSE feedback. RAID infers a primary retrieval intent from source content, refines it through 4W multi-role deep reflection on prospective searchers' information needs, and uses both the primary and refined intents to jointly plan and rewrite source content. We further extend GEO-BENCH with diverse topic-related query variants, using both the original queries and their variants exclusively for evaluation to assess generalization to queries unseen during optimization. Across 100 samples and 500 evaluation queries, RAID achieves Relative Improvement Scores (RIS) of 3.00\% for Objective Overall and 1.32\% for Subjective Average, exceeding the best corresponding results among the nine predefined GEO rewriting strategies by 1.31 and 0.74 percentage points, respectively. With an optimization considered effective when $\mathrm{RIS}>0$, its effective optimization rates for Objective Overall and Subjective Average average 58.0\%, exceeding the highest corresponding average among the predefined strategies by 4.5 percentage points.

AI.title_translation: 角色增强的意图驱动生成式搜索引擎优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RAID的生成式搜索引擎优化方法，在无法预知用户查询的情况下，通过多角色反思和意图驱动来优化网页内容，显著提升了其在生成式搜索引擎中的可见性和影响力。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）方法大多依赖于对目标查询或搜索引擎反馈的直接访问。然而，在实际中，网络内容通常在未知未来用户查询的情况下进行优化和发布，因此研究在没有目标查询及其反馈情况下的G-SEO具有重要现实意义且亟待探索。
AI.method: 提出RAID（Role-Augmented Intent-Driven G-SEO）方法。该方法从源内容中推断主要检索意图，通过4W多角色深度反思对准潜在搜索者的信息需求进行细化，并结合主要意图与细化意图对源内容进行联合规划和重写。
AI.result: 在包含100个样本和500个评估查询的实验中，RAID在客观总体和主观平均上的相对改进得分（RIS）分别达到3.00%和1.32%，超越了九种预定义GEO重写策略中的最佳结果；其有效优化率平均达到58.0%，比最高基线高出4.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的RAID方法通过角色增强和意图驱动，在无法获取目标查询和反馈的现实场景下，有效提升了源内容在生成式搜索引擎中的可见性和影响力，展现出优秀的泛化能力和优化效果。
AI.translation: 结合了大语言模型（LLMs）与检索增强生成（RAG）的生成式搜索引擎（GSEs），正在重塑用户访问网络信息的方式，并使生成回答中的来源可见性和影响力成为新的优化目标。现有的生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）方法旨在提高内容可见性，但许多方法依赖于直接访问目标查询或由这些查询激发的GSE反馈。然而，网络内容通常在未来用户查询未知之前就被优化和发布，这使得在没有目标查询或其相关反馈的情况下的G-SEO成为一个重要但尚未充分探索的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RAID，一种角色增强的意图驱动G-SEO方法，它在不访问目标查询或依赖查询的GSE反馈的情况下运行。RAID从源内容中推断出主要的检索意图，通过对预期搜索者信息需求的4W多角色深度反思对其进行细化，并利用主要意图和细化意图共同规划和重写源内容。我们进一步扩展了包含多样化主题相关查询变体的GEO-BENCH，仅使用原始查询及其变体进行评估，以评测对优化期间未见查询的泛化能力。在100个样本和500个评估查询中，RAID在客观总体（Objective Overall）和主观平均（Subjective Average）上分别实现了3.00%和1.32%的相对改进得分（RIS），分别比九种预定义GEO重写策略中的最佳对应结果高出1.31和0.74个百分点。当优化被认为有效时（$\mathrm{RIS}>0$），其客观总体和主观平均的有效优化率平均达到58.0%，超过了预定义策略中的最高对应平均值4.5个百分点。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了无目标查询和反馈场景下的生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）问题，并提出了一种名为RAID的新方法。RAID通过提取源内容的主要意图，并利用多角色深度反思来模拟潜在搜索者的需求，进而对内容进行联合规划和重写，显著提升了内容在生成式搜索引擎中的可见性和优化效果。
AI.keywords: 生成式搜索引擎优化, 检索增强生成, 意图驱动, 角色增强, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对生成式搜索引擎优化（G-SEO）中缺乏目标查询及反馈的现实痛点，创新性地提出了基于多角色深度反思和意图驱动的内容重写方法（RAID）。该方法在不依赖未来查询的情况下，通过模拟潜在搜索者的信息需求来优化源内容，具有很强的实用价值和泛化能力。实验结果验证了其在客观和主观指标上的优越性。

title: Re4: Scientific Computing Agent with Rewriting, Resolution, Review and Revision
comments: Under minor revision at Machine Learning: Science and Technology (IOP Publishing)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated abilities to perform complex tasks in multiple domains, including mathematical and scientific reasoning. In this work, we construct a novel agent framework for solving representative problems in scientific computing. The proposed agent incorporates a "rewriting-resolution-review-revision" logical chain via three reasoning LLMs (the Consultant, Reviewer, and Programmer) in a collaborative and interactive manner. The Consultant module enables knowledge transfer to link problems to professional domain insights, thereby rewriting problem descriptions through text augmentation. The Programmer module generates and executes well-structured code to solve problems. The Reviewer module enables self-debugging and self-refinement through interactive feedback with code runtime outputs. Through the end-to-end review mechanism, the Programmer's executable code undergoes iterative revision. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on typical partial differential equations (PDEs), engineering-oriented flow past a cylinder, ill-conditioned linear systems, and data-driven physical analysis problems. Compared with a single-model approach, this collaborative framework significantly improves the bug-free code generation rate and reduces non-physical solutions, establishing a reliable framework for autonomous code generation from natural language descriptions. The review mechanism improved the average execution success (bug-free code and non-NaN solutions) rate of DeepSeek R1 from 59% to 82%, while ChatGPT 4.1-mini improved from 66% to 87% and Gemini-2.5 improved from 60% to 84%. Automatic code generation and review provide a promising workflow for scientific computing; analysis of solver-development trajectories further reveals recurring implementation difficulties in boundary treatment, array indexing, and the preservation of numerical constraints.

AI.title_translation: Re4：具备重写、求解、审阅与修正功能的科学计算智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Re4的多智能体科学计算框架，通过重写、求解、审阅和修正的迭代机制，显著提升了大语言模型在科学计算中的代码生成和执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在多个领域展现出复杂任务处理能力，但在科学计算任务中仍面临代码错误率高、易产生非物理解等挑战，亟需建立一个能够实现自主、可靠代码生成的科学计算智能体框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含顾问（Consultant）、审阅者（Reviewer）和程序员（Programmer）三个推理大模型的协作交互框架，实现了“重写-求解-审阅-修正”（Rewriting-Resolution-Review-Revision）的逻辑链，通过文本增强、代码生成执行以及基于运行时输出的交互式反馈进行自我调试和迭代修正。
AI.result: 实验表明，与单一模型方法相比，该协作框架显著提高了无bug代码生成率并减少了非物理解。审查机制使DeepSeek R1的平均执行成功率从59%提高到82%，ChatGPT 4.1-mini从66%提高到87%，Gemini-2.5从60%提高到84%。
AI.conclusion: Re4框架通过多智能体协作与迭代审查机制，显著提升了大语言模型在科学计算任务中的代码生成和执行成功率，为自动生成可靠的科学计算代码提供了一个有前景的工作流。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）已在包括数学和科学推理在内的多个领域展现出执行复杂任务的能力。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个用于解决科学计算代表性问题的新型智能体框架。所提出的智能体通过三个推理大模型（顾问、审阅者和程序员）以协作和交互的方式，结合了“重写-求解-审阅-修正”的逻辑链。顾问模块通过知识转移将问题与专业领域见解联系起来，从而通过文本增强重写问题描述。程序员模块生成并执行结构良好的代码来解决问题。审阅者模块通过与代码运行时输出的交互式反馈，实现自我调试和自我精炼。通过端到端的审阅机制，程序员的可执行代码经历迭代修正。我们在典型偏微分方程（PDEs）、面向工程的绕圆流动、病态线性系统以及数据驱动的物理分析问题上对该框架进行了全面评估。与单一模型方法相比，这种协作框架显著提高了无bug代码生成的比率并减少了非物理解，为从自然语言描述进行自主代码生成建立了一个可靠的框架。审阅机制使DeepSeek R1的平均执行成功率（无bug代码和非NaN解）从59%提高到82%，ChatGPT 4.1-mini从66%提高到87%，Gemini-2.5从60%提高到84%。自动代码生成和审阅为科学计算提供了一个有前景的工作流；对求解器开发轨迹的分析进一步揭示了边界处理、数组索引和数值约束保持方面反复出现的实现难点。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Re4的科学计算智能体框架，利用三个大模型通过“重写-求解-审阅-修正”的协作逻辑链来解决科学计算中的复杂问题。该框架显著提高了偏微分方程和工程流量等典型科学计算任务中的代码无bug率和执行成功率。
AI.keywords: 科学计算智能体, 大语言模型, 偏微分方程, 代码生成, 自我修正
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种专为科学计算设计的创新多智能体框架（Re4），通过重写、求解、审查和修正的逻辑链条，有效解决了大模型在科学计算中常见的代码错误和非物理解问题，显著提升了代码生成与执行的成功率。

title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
summary: This paper introduces Quaternion Approximate Networks (QUAN), a novel deep learning framework that leverages quaternion algebra for rotation equivariant image classification and object detection. Unlike conventional quaternion neural networks attempting to operate entirely in the quaternion domain, QUAN approximates quaternion convolution through Hamilton product decomposition using real-valued operations. This approach preserves geometric properties while enabling efficient implementation with custom CUDA kernels. We introduce Independent Quaternion Batch Normalization (IQBN) for training stability and extend quaternion operations to spatial attention mechanisms. QUAN is evaluated on image classification (CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet), object detection (COCO, DOTA), and robotic perception tasks. In classification tasks, QUAN achieves higher accuracy with fewer parameters and faster convergence compared to existing convolution and quaternion-based models. For objection detection, QUAN demonstrates improved parameter efficiency and rotation handling over standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) while establishing the SOTA for quaternion CNNs in this downstream task. These results highlight its potential for deployment in resource-constrained robotic systems requiring rotation-aware perception and application in other domains. Code: https://cwru-aism.github.io/ QUANpaper/

AI.title_translation: 用于增强图像分类和旋转目标检测的四元数近似网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了四元数近似网络（QUAN），通过实值运算高效近似四元数卷积，在图像分类和旋转目标检测中实现了高精度、高参数效率和出色的旋转处理能力。
AI.motivation: 传统四元数神经网络试图完全在四元数域中运行，导致计算效率低下；同时资源受限的机器人系统需要具备旋转感知能力的高效图像分类和目标检测模型。
AI.method: 提出了四元数近似网络（QUAN），通过哈密顿乘积分解用实值运算近似四元数卷积，引入独立四元数批归一化（IQBN）并扩展至空间注意力机制。
AI.result: 在图像分类任务中，QUAN以更少的参数和更快的收敛速度实现了更高精度；在目标检测任务中，展现出比标准CNN更好的参数效率和旋转处理能力，并确立了四元数CNN在该下游任务中的SOTA地位。
AI.conclusion: QUAN框架通过近似四元数卷积和独立四元数批归一化，成功解决了传统四元数网络计算效率低的问题，为资源受限的机器人系统提供了高效的旋转感知解决方案。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了四元数近似网络（QUAN），这是一种利用四元数代数实现旋转等变图像分类和目标检测的新型深度学习框架。与试图完全在四元数域中运行的传统四元数神经网络不同，QUAN通过使用实值运算的哈密顿乘积分解来近似四元数卷积。这种方法在保持几何属性的同时，通过自定义CUDA核实现了高效实现。我们引入了独立四元数批归一化（IQBN）来提高训练稳定性，并将四元数操作扩展到空间注意力机制。QUAN在图像分类（CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet）、目标检测（COCO、DOTA）和机器人感知任务上进行了评估。在分类任务中，与现有的卷积和基于四元数的模型相比，QUAN以更少的参数和更快的收敛速度实现了更高的准确率。对于目标检测，QUAN展示了比标准卷积神经网络（CNN）更高的参数效率和旋转处理能力，同时在该下游任务中确立了四元数CNN的SOTA（最先进水平）。这些结果突出了其在需要旋转感知感知的资源受限机器人系统以及其他领域应用的潜力。代码：https://cwru-aism.github.io/QUANpaper/
AI.summary: 本文提出了四元数近似网络（QUAN），利用哈密顿乘积分解和实值运算近似四元数卷积，结合独立四元数批归一化与空间注意力机制，实现了高效、具有旋转等变性的图像分类与目标检测。
AI.keywords: 四元数神经网络, 图像分类, 旋转目标检测, 旋转等变性, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将四元数代数与实值运算的高效性结合，通过哈密顿乘积分解和自定义CUDA核，实现了旋转等变性和参数效率的显著提升，在图像分类和旋转目标检测任务中表现优异。

title: Detection of trade in products derived from threatened species using machine learning and a smartphone application
summary: Illegal and unsustainable wildlife trade remains a major conservation challenge and is increasingly shifting to online marketplaces where monitoring is difficult. To address this gap, we used real-world images from online platforms, enforcement seizures, and market inspections to develop a deep-learning object detection framework to identify products derived from three highly traded species: elephant, pangolin, and tiger. Our dataset of 39,941 images included both wildlife products and visually similar non-wildlife items, reflecting real enforcement complexity. We used cross-entropy and asymmetric focal loss functions to train Faster Region-based convolutional neural network (Faster R-CNN) models and compared species-specific and multispecies training strategies. The best-performing model, trained with cross-entropy on all species combined, achieved an overall accuracy of 84.2%, with high performance for pangolin (93.6%) and tiger (90.3%) and moderate performance for elephant (71.1%). Although asymmetric focal loss increased recall, it substantially reduced precision. We deployed the optimized model in a prototype smartphone application, potentially usable in real-world settings for monitoring online images. With an independent test set, the application achieved 91.3% accuracy and an F-score of 0.86. These results demonstrate the potential of object detection models to support scalable, real-time monitoring of wildlife trade and enable the rapid triage of suspicious posts, regulatory compliance, and conservation decision-making.

AI.title_translation: 使用机器学习和智能手机应用检测源自受威胁物种的产品的贸易
AI.tldr: 利用深度学习和手机应用自动检测网络上的受威胁野生动物制品，助力打击非法野生动物贸易。
AI.motivation: 非法和不可持续的野生动物贸易是一个重大的保护挑战，且正日益向难以监测的网络市场转移。为了弥补这一监测空白，开发能够自动识别威胁物种制品的工具。
AI.method: 利用来自在线平台、执法查扣和市场检查的39,941张真实图像数据集，采用Faster R-CNN模型，应用交叉熵和非对称焦点损失函数，并对比了物种特定与多物种的训练策略。随后将优化后的模型部署到原型智能手机应用中。
AI.result: 最佳模型实现了84.2%的总体准确率，其中穿山甲（93.6%）和老虎（90.3%）表现优异，大象（71.1%）表现中等。部署在智能手机应用上的优化模型在独立测试集上达到了91.3%的准确率和0.86的F分数。
AI.conclusion: 基于机器学习的目标检测框架和智能手机应用程序能够有效识别大象、穿山甲和老虎等威胁物种制品，为打击非法野生动物贸易提供了可扩展、实时的技术支持。
AI.translation: 非法和不可持续的野生动物贸易仍然是一个主要的保护挑战，并且正日益向监测困难的网络市场转移。为了解决这一差距，我们利用来自在线平台、执法查扣和市场检查的真实世界图像，开发了一个深度学习目标检测框架，以识别源自三个高度贸易物种的产品：大象、穿山甲和老虎。我们的39,941张图像数据集包括野生动物制品和视觉上相似的非野生动物物品，反映了现实中执法的复杂性。我们使用交叉熵和非对称焦点损失函数来训练Faster R-CNN模型，并比较了物种特定和多物种的训练策略。表现最好的模型使用交叉熵对所有物种组合进行训练，总体准确率达到84.2%，其中穿山甲（93.6%）和老虎（90.3%）表现高，大象（71.1%）表现中等。尽管非对称焦点损失增加了召回率，但大幅降低了精度。我们将优化后的模型部署到一个原型的智能手机应用程序中，该程序有可能在现实世界中用于监测网络图像。通过独立的测试集，该应用实现了91.3%的准确率和0.86的F分数。这些结果证明了目标检测模型支持野生动物贸易的可扩展、实时监测的潜力，并能够实现可疑帖子的快速分诊、法规遵从和保护决策。
AI.summary: 该研究开发了一个基于深度学习目标检测的框架和智能手机应用，用于识别来自大象、穿山甲和老虎的制品，以解决在线非法野生动物贸易难以监测的问题，并在测试中取得了高准确率。
AI.keywords: 野生动物贸易, 深度学习, 目标检测, 智能手机应用, 保护生物学
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将深度学习目标检测模型与智能手机应用相结合，用于打击威胁物种的非法野生动物贸易。通过结合真实世界的复杂图像数据，该研究展示了AI技术在实际执法、在线监测以及生态保护中的巨大潜力和应用前景。

title: How K-12 Teachers Adapt Generative AI to Local Classroom Demands: Cultural Distance Between GenAI Defaults and Everyday Teaching Practices
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) is entering K-12 classrooms, but its default culture does not always fit local teaching. Existing accounts either treat this misfit as macro-level structural bias or examine it through single-case studies; neither captures how much work teachers must do to make outputs usable across tasks. This exploratory, theory-building qualitative study introduces cultural distance, the gap between GenAI's default cultural repertoire and the situated demands of teachers' practice. Through interviews with 30 K-12 teachers who frequently use GenAI, 10 each from South Africa, Taiwan, and the United States, we identified three levels defined by the effort teachers invested and whether it yielded a usable output: low (minor edits), mid (sustained prompting and revision), and high (structural gaps rooted in unsupported languages, undigitized knowledge, or policy filters that no teacher effort can close). We present cultural distance as a promising framework requiring further examination and draw implications for designers, policymakers, and educators.

AI.title_translation: K-12教师如何调整生成式AI以适应当地课堂需求：生成式AI默认设置与日常教学实践之间的文化距离
AI.tldr: 本研究通过对30位K-12教师的访谈，提出了“文化距离”框架，解释了生成式AI默认设置与教师实践需求之间的差距，并根据教师调整AI产出的努力程度将其分为低、中、高三个级别。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在进入K-12课堂，但其默认文化与当地教学实践不符。现有研究未能充分捕捉教师为使AI产出可用而付出的努力，因此本研究旨在通过引入“文化距离”概念来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 本研究是一项探索性的、以构建理论为目的的定性研究。研究通过访谈了来自南非、台湾和美国的30位经常使用生成式AI的K-12教师，每地10名。
AI.result: 研究识别了“文化距离”，即生成式AI默认文化库与教师实践情境需求之间的差距。根据教师投入的努力以及是否产生可用输出，将文化距离分为三个级别：低（少量编辑）、中（持续提示和修改）、高（源于不支持的语言、未数字化的知识或政策限制造成的结构性差距，教师努力无法弥补）。
AI.conclusion: “文化距离”是一个有前景的框架，需要进一步研究，并对设计师、政策制定者和教育工作者具有启示意义。
AI.translation: 生成式AI（GenAI）正在进入K-12课堂，但其默认文化并非总能适应当地教学。现有描述要么将这种不匹配视为宏观层面的结构性偏见，要么通过单一案例研究进行考察；两者都未能捕捉到教师为使AI产出在各项任务中可用所必须付出的工作量。这项探索性的、旨在构建理论的定性研究引入了“文化距离”概念，即生成式AI的默认文化库与教师实践的情境需求之间的差距。通过对30位经常使用生成式AI的K-12教师进行访谈，他们分别来自南非、台湾和美国，每个地区10名，我们根据教师投入的努力以及是否产生了可用输出，确定了三个级别：低（少量编辑）、中（持续提示和修改）、高（源于不支持的语言、未数字化的知识或政策过滤器造成的结构性差距，任何教师的努力都无法弥补）。我们提出“文化距离”是一个有前景的框架，需要进一步审查，并为设计师、政策制定者和教育工作者提供了启示。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了K-12教师如何调整生成式AI以适应当地课堂需求，引入了“文化距离”概念，旨在描述生成式AI默认设置与日常教学实践之间的不匹配。通过对来自南非、台湾和美国的30位K-12教师进行访谈，研究根据教师为使AI产出可用所付出的努力程度，将文化距离分为低、中、高三个级别。研究结果提出“文化距离”作为理解AI在教育中应用的框架，并对AI设计者、政策制定者和教育者提出了建议。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, K-12教师, 文化距离, 课堂需求, 教学实践
AI.comments: 本论文创新性地提出了“文化距离”这一概念，为理解生成式AI在K-12教育中应用的挑战提供了新的视角。它超越了宏观结构性偏见或单一案例研究的局限，深入探讨了教师在实际操作中面临的具体困境和所需付出的努力，这对于AI产品设计和教育政策制定具有重要的指导意义。

title: From Legacy Fortran to Portable Kokkos: An Autonomous Agentic AI Workflow
summary: Scientific applications continue to rely on legacy Fortran codebases originally developed for homogeneous, CPU-based systems. As High-Performance Computing (HPC) shifts toward heterogeneous GPU-accelerated architectures, many accelerators lack native Fortran bindings, creating an urgent need to modernize legacy codes for portability. Frameworks like Kokkos provide performance portability and a single-source C++ abstraction, but manual Fortran-to-Kokkos porting demands significant expertise and time. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in source-to-source code generation, yet their use in fully autonomous workflows for translating and optimizing parallel code remains largely unexplored, especially for performance portability across diverse hardware. This paper presents an agentic AI workflow where specialized LLM "agents" collaborate to translate, validate, compile, run, test, debug, and optimize Fortran kernels into portable Kokkos C++ programs. Results show the pipeline modernizes a range of benchmark kernels, producing performance-portable Kokkos codes across hardware partitions. Paid OpenAI models such as GPT-5 and o4-mini-high executed the workflow for only a few U.S. dollars, generating optimized codes that surpassed Fortran baselines, whereas open-source models like Llama4-Maverick often failed to yield functional codes. This work demonstrates the feasibility of agentic AI for Fortran-to-Kokkos transformation and offers a pathway for autonomously modernizing legacy scientific applications to run portably and efficiently on diverse supercomputers. It further highlights the potential of LLM-driven agentic systems to perform structured, domain-specific reasoning tasks in scientific and systems-oriented applications.

AI.title_translation: 从遗留Fortran到可移植Kokkos：一种自主智能体AI工作流
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于LLM智能体的工作流，能将遗留Fortran代码自动转换为高性能、可移植的Kokkos C++代码，并在不同硬件上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 科学应用继续依赖最初为同构、CPU系统开发的遗留Fortran代码库。随着高性能计算 (HPC) 转向异构GPU加速架构，许多加速器缺乏原生的Fortran绑定，这迫切需要现代化遗留代码以实现可移植性。手动将Fortran移植到Kokkos需要大量的专业知识和时间，而LLM在完全自主工作流中用于翻译和优化并行代码的用途仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种智能体AI工作流，其中专门的LLM“智能体”协作翻译、验证、编译、运行、测试、调试和优化Fortran内核，使其成为可移植的Kokkos C++程序。
AI.result: 该流水线成功现代化了一系列基准内核，在不同硬件分区上生成了性能可移植的Kokkos代码。付费OpenAI模型（如GPT-5和o4-mini-high）仅花费几美元就执行了该工作流，生成的优化代码超越了Fortran基线；而开源模型（如Llama4-Maverick）通常未能生成功能性代码。
AI.conclusion: 本工作证明了智能体AI在Fortran到Kokkos转换中的可行性，并为自主现代化遗留科学应用以在不同超级计算机上可移植且高效运行提供了途径。它进一步强调了LLM驱动的智能体系统在科学和系统导向应用中执行结构化、领域特定推理任务的潜力。

summary: The rapid advancement of Low-Power Wide Area Networks (LPWANs), particularly Long Range (LoRa) technology, has positioned them as a cornerstone of Next-Generation Internet of Things (NG-IoT) applications. Despite their long-range and low-power advantages, achieving high energy efficiency (EE) in LoRa networks remains a significant challenge in highly dynamic environments. Traditional terrestrial gateway deployments often suffer from coverage gaps and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation, while satellite-based alternatives incur excessive energy consumption and prohibitive latency. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-UAV architecture in which unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) serve as mobile LoRa gateways to dynamically collect data from LoRa end devices (EDs). We formulate a joint optimization problem to maximize the weighted system EE by jointly optimizing spreading factors, transmission powers, UAV trajectories, and ED-UAV associations. This problem is transformed into a partially observable stochastic game (POSG), which we solve using our proposed Green LoRa Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (GLo-MAPPO). We adopt PPO because its clipped surrogate objective discourages excessively large policy updates, thereby promoting stable learning as multiple UAV agents simultaneously adapt their behaviors. Combined with centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE), this enables coordinated policy learning while allowing each UAV to make decisions independently during execution. Simulation results show that GLo-MAPPO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) benchmarks in terms of EE and power consumption across varying network densities. title: Development of Deep Learning Optimizers: Approaches, Concepts, and Update Rules
comments: Published as a conference paper at IDAP 2026. 19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables
summary: Deep learning optimizers are optimization algorithms that enable deep neural networks to learn. The effectiveness of learning is highly dependent on the optimizer employed in the training process. Alongside the rapid advancement of deep learning, a wide range of optimizers with different approaches have been developed. This study aims to provide a review of various optimizers that have been proposed and received attention in the literature. From Stochastic gradient descent to the most recent ones such as Momentum, AdamW, Sophia, and Muon in chronological order, optimizers are examined individually, and their distinctive features are highlighted in the study. The update rule of each optimizer is presented in detail, with an explanation of the associated concepts and variables. The techniques applied by these optimizers, their contributions to the optimization process, and their default hyperparameter settings are also discussed. In addition, insights are offered into the open challenges encountered in the optimization of deep learning models. Thus, a comprehensive resource is provided both for understanding the current state of optimizers and for identifying potential areas of future development.

title: Real-Time Object Detection Meets DINOv3
summary: Driven by the simple and effective Dense O2O, DEIM demonstrates faster convergence and enhanced performance. In this work, we extend it with DINOv3 features, resulting in DEIMv2. DEIMv2 spans eight model sizes from X to Atto, covering GPU, edge, and mobile deployment. For the X, L, M, and S variants, we adopt DINOv3-pretrained or distilled backbones and introduce a Spatial Tuning Adapter (STA), which efficiently converts DINOv3's single-scale output into multi-scale features and complements strong semantics with fine-grained details to enhance detection. For ultra-lightweight models (Nano, Pico, Femto, and Atto), we employ HGNetv2 with depth and width pruning to meet strict resource budgets. Together with a simplified decoder and an upgraded Dense O2O, this unified design enables DEIMv2 to achieve a superior performance-cost trade-off across diverse scenarios, establishing new state-of-the-art results. Notably, our largest model, DEIMv2-X, achieves 57.8 AP with only 50.3 million parameters, surpassing prior X-scale models that require over 60 million parameters for just 56.5 AP. On the compact side, DEIMv2-S is the first sub-10 million model (9.71 million) to exceed the 50 AP milestone on COCO, reaching 50.9 AP. Even the ultra-lightweight DEIMv2-Pico, with just 1.5 million parameters, delivers 38.5 AP, matching YOLOv10-Nano (2.3 million) with around 50 percent fewer parameters. Our code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/Intellindust-AI-Lab/DEIMv2

title: On The Variability of Concept Activation Vectors
comments: 55 pages (9 main text + appendix), 73 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026
summary: One of the most pressing challenges in artificial intelligence is to make models more transparent to their users. Recently, explainable artificial intelligence has come up with numerous methods to tackle this challenge. A promising avenue is to use concept-based explanations, that is, high-level concepts instead of plain feature importance scores. Among this class of methods, Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs, Kim et al., 2018) stand out as one of the main protagonists. One interesting aspect of CAVs is that their computation requires sampling random examples from the train set. Therefore, the actual vectors obtained may vary depending on the randomness of this sampling. In this paper, we propose a fine-grained theoretical analysis of CAV construction in order to quantify their variability. Our results, confirmed by experiments on several real-life datasets of four different modalities, point to an universal result: the variance of CAVs declines roughly as $1/N$, where $N$ is the number of random examples. Based on this, we give practical recommendations for a resource-efficient application of the method.

AI.method: 提出对CAV构建过程的精细化理论分析，以量化其变异性，并在四个不同模态的真实数据集上进行了实验验证。

AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析与多模态实验，证明了CAV方差与随机样本量$N$呈$1/N$的反比关系，并据此提出了资源高效应用的实用建议。
AI.translation: 人工智能领域最紧迫的挑战之一是增强模型对用户的透明度。近年来，可解释人工智能涌现出大量方法来应对这一挑战。一个有前景的途径是使用基于概念的解释，即使用高级概念来代替单纯的特征重要性得分。在这类方法中，概念激活向量（CAVs, Kim et al., 2018）是最主要的代表之一。CAVs的一个有趣之处在于，它们的计算需要从训练集中随机采样样本。因此，实际获得的向量可能会随采样随机性的不同而变化。在本文中，我们对CAV的构建进行了细致的理论分析，以量化其变异性。我们的研究结果在四个不同模态的多个真实数据集上得到了实验证实，指向了一个普遍规律：CAVs的方差大致以 $1/N$ 的速度下降，其中 $N$ 是随机样本的数量。基于此，我们为该方法的资源高效应用提出了实用建议。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了可解释AI中概念激活向量（CAV）的变异性问题。通过细致的理论分析和多模态数据集的实验，作者发现CAV的方差随随机样本数量$N$的增加近似以 $1/N$ 的速度下降，并基于此提出了优化资源利用的实用建议。
AI.keywords: 可解释人工智能, 概念激活向量, 变异性分析, 理论分析, 资源效率
AI.comments: 该论文对概念激活向量（CAV）的变异性进行了深入的理论与实验分析，发现其方差随样本量呈1/N的规律下降，对提高可解释性AI的稳定性和资源效率具有重要指导意义。

title: LoBE-GS: Load-Balanced and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has established itself as an efficient representation for real-time, high-fidelity 3D scene reconstruction. However, scaling 3DGS to large and unbounded scenes such as city blocks remains difficult. Existing divide-and-conquer methods alleviate memory pressure by partitioning the scene into blocks and training on multiple, non-communicating GPUs, but introduce new bottlenecks: (i) partitions suffer from severe load imbalance since uniform or heuristic splits do not reflect actual computational demands, and (ii) coarse-to-fine pipelines fail to exploit the coarse stage efficiently, often reloading the entire model and incurring high overhead. In this work, we introduce LoBE-GS, a Load-Balanced and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting framework, that re-engineers the large-scale 3DGS pipeline. Specifically, LoBE-GS introduces a load-balanced KD-tree scene partitioning scheme with optimized cutlines that balance per-block camera counts. To accelerate preprocessing, it employs depth-based back-projection for fast camera assignment, reducing processing time from hours to minutes. It further reduces training cost through two lightweight techniques: visibility cropping and selective densification. On large-scale urban and outdoor datasets, LoBE-GS reduces scene-partitioning time by up to an order of magnitude and worst-block fine-training time by up to $3.2\times$ relative to CityGaussian. It also substantially reduces end-to-end and post-coarse training time under matched GPU budgets while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. LoBE-GS thus provides a communication-free alternative with favorable quality-efficiency trade-offs. The associated code is available at: https://github.com/Sunnyhong0326/lobe-gs

title: CLEAR-IR: Clarity-Enhanced Active Reconstruction of Infrared Imagery
comments: Accepted and presented in IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026. Project page: https://ladoszlabs.github.io/clearir/
summary: This paper presents CLEAR-IR (Clarity Enhanced Active Reconstruction of Infrared Imagery), a novel framework for enabling robust robotic perception in dark environments using active infrared (IR) sensing. IR streams are less susceptible to noise than RGB in low light conditions but are dominated by structured light emitter patterns that hinder high level tasks such as object detection, tracking, and localisation. CLEAR-IR addresses this by reconstructing clean, RGB styled images from emitter populated IR inputs using a dual stream architecture inspired by DeepMAO, enabling standard RGB trained vision pipelines to operate without visible light. Evaluation across object detection, ArUco marker detection, and visual SLAM demonstrates that CLEAR-IR produces reliable perception in conditions ranging from well lit to completely dark, where passive RGB based enhancement methods fail entirely due to the physical absence of sensor signal.

title: MultiFair: Multimodal Balanced Fairness-Aware Medical Classification with Dual-Level Gradient Modulation
comments: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Medical decision systems increasingly rely on data from multiple sources to ensure reliable and unbiased diagnosis. However, existing multimodal learning models fail to achieve this goal because they often overlook two critical challenges. First, various data modalities may learn unevenly, thereby converging to a model biased towards certain modalities. Second, the model may emphasize learning on certain demographic groups causing unfair performances. The two aspects can influence each other, as different data modalities may favor respective groups during optimization, leading to both imbalanced and unfair multimodal learning. This paper proposes a novel approach called MultiFair for multimodal medical classification, which addresses these challenges with a dual-level gradient modulation process. MultiFair dynamically modulates training gradients regarding the optimization direction and magnitude at both data modality and group levels. We evaluate MultiFair on three real-world medical classification datasets with diverse demographic attributes,including multiclass classification and missing-modality settings. Experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.title_translation: MultiFair：基于双层梯度调制的医学多模态平衡公平性分类
AI.tldr: MultiFair提出了一种双层梯度调制方法，解决了多模态医学分类中模态学习不平衡和群体表现不公平的问题。

AI.result: 在三个具有不同人口属性的真实世界医学分类数据集上，包括多类别分类和模态缺失设置，实验结果证明了MultiFair的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MultiFair通过解决多模态学习中的模态不平衡和群体不公平问题，提升了医学分类系统的可靠性和无偏性。
AI.translation: 医学决策系统越来越依赖来自多个来源的数据，以确保可靠和无偏的诊断。然而，现有的多模态学习模型未能实现这一目标，因为它们常常忽视两个关键挑战。首先，各种数据模态可能学习不均匀，从而导致模型偏向某些模态。其次，模型可能侧重于在某些人口群体上学习，导致性能不公平。这两个方面可以相互影响，因为不同的数据模态在优化过程中可能偏向各自的群体，从而导致不平衡和不公平的多模态学习。本文提出了一种名为MultiFair的新型多模态医学分类方法，通过双层梯度调制过程解决这些挑战。MultiFair在数据模态和群体层面，根据优化方向和幅度动态调制训练梯度。我们在三个具有不同人口属性的真实世界医学分类数据集上评估了MultiFair，包括多类别分类和模态缺失设置。实验结果证明了其有效性。
AI.summary: 本论文提出MultiFair，一种用于多模态医学分类的新方法，旨在解决现有模型中存在的模态学习不平衡和对特定群体表现不公平的问题。MultiFair通过在数据模态和群体两个层面动态调制训练梯度（包括优化方向和幅度）来实现平衡和公平的学习。在多类别分类和模态缺失设置下的三个真实世界医学数据集上的实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 多模态学习, 公平性, 医学分类, 梯度调制, 不平衡学习
AI.comments: MultiFair的创新点在于其双层梯度调制机制，能够同时解决多模态数据学习不平衡和群体公平性问题，这对于提升医学诊断系统的可靠性和公平性具有重要意义。

title: A Closer Look at Evaluation of Text-to-Video Models Under Camera Motion
comments: Accepted at WACV 2027. 22 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Access the project page in https://nithincbabu7.github.io/DynamicEval
summary: Existing text-to-video (T2V) evaluation benchmarks, such as VBench and EvalCrafter, predominantly contain either subject-centric prompts or static camera scenes, overlooking the importance of camera motion, essential for producing cinematic shots with realistic scenes. Due to this, the metrics developed in these works often produce incorrect results in the presence of camera motion. To fill this gap, we introduce DynamicEval, a benchmark comprising of systematically curated prompts that emphasize dynamic camera motion, paired with 45k human annotations on video pairs. DynamicEval evaluates two key dimensions of video quality: the consistency of the foreground subjects and the consistency of the background scene. To address the shortcomings of existing metrics under camera motion, we introduce two novel metrics: 1) Tracker-FG, which evaluates subject consistency by assessing the keypoint tracks of the subject. 2) Debiased Motion Smoothness, for background consistency, devoid from issues of occlusions/disocclusions arising from camera and foreground subject movements. Extensive experiments on the large-scale DynamicEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed metrics achieve stronger correlations with human preferences at both the video level, and the model level with an increase of 0.32 in average Pearson Linear Correlation.
